About Revolte 




Revolte is building AI for Software Engineering.




We are creating an AI-native platform that helps engineering teams execute the software delivery lifecycle with speed, quality, and control - from planning and implementation to testing, release, governance, and production feedback.




We're looking for a Full Stack Software Engineer II who can work across the frontend and backend, take ownership of features end to end, and build scalable, production-ready applications in a fast-moving AI-first environment.




Responsibilities




Design, develop, and ship scalable full-stack applications and production-ready features.Build responsive, high-performance frontend experiences and reliable backend services.Develop and integrate REST APIs, microservices, third-party services, and AI-powered capabilities.Work across the entire development lifecycle, from technical design and implementation to testing, deployment, and production support.Collaborate closely with Product, Design, AI, Backend, and Platform Engineering teams.Build reusable frontend components and maintain scalable application architecture.Improve application performance, reliability, security, and overall user experience.Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, debugging, and technical decision-making.Contribute to CI/CD, cloud deployments, observability, and engineering best practices.Mentor junior engineers and contribute to improving team engineering standards.Stay current with modern web, cloud, AI, and software engineering technologies.


What We Are Looking For




3–5 years of professional experience in full-stack software development.Strong experience building and shipping production-grade web applications.Ability to work confidently across frontend and backend systems.Strong understanding of software architecture, APIs, databases, and distributed systems.Strong problem-solving, debugging, and analytical skills.Experience taking ownership of features from concept to production.Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.Strong communication skills and a willingness to mentor and support other engineers.Interest in AI, developer tools, cloud infrastructure, and modern software engineering.


Technical Skills




Strong proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript, React.js, and Next.js.Strong backend experience with Node.js, Python, Go, or Java.Experience building RESTful APIs, microservices, and third-party integrations.Experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, or similar technologies.Strong understanding of HTML, CSS, responsive design, and frontend performance.Experience with Git, GitHub, testing frameworks, and CI/CD workflows.Hands-on experience with Docker and familiarity with Kubernetes.Experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.Understanding of system design, asynchronous processing, caching, and event-driven architectures.Familiarity with observability, logging, monitoring, and production troubleshooting.Experience with AI/LLM APIs, RAG, embeddings, or AI agents is a strong plus.Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and modern developer workflows is desirable.


Why Join Revolte




Build the future of AI-powered software engineering.Work across AI, full-stack engineering, cloud infrastructure, and developer experience.Solve complex technical problems and build systems used by modern engineering teams.Work closely with experienced engineers, AI specialists, designers, and product teams.Own features end to end and see your work move from idea to production.Work with modern technologies and continuously expand your technical expertise.Mentor and influence engineering practices as Revolte grows.Join a high-ownership AI-first company where your work directly contributes to shaping the future of software engineering.

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.
At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations. Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation. In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.


The Global Information Security (GIS) is responsible for protecting Bank information systems, confidential and proprietary data, and customer information. Cyber Security technology function is responsible of development and maintenance of security products across Bank of America. The individual (Senior Developer) will be responsible for the development and orientation of applications servicing Global Information Security teams. A developer in this role has experience working with Security Information Event Management technologies and can develop in python in AGILE teams. The job requires a strong focus on solving problems experienced by front line analysts to deliver quality metadata in user friendly formats.
In this role, you will be using the experience you have gained throughout your career to assist in the design, development, and implementation of SIEM and SOAR capabilities across an Enterprise environment.  We believe it is important that you follow best practices established by the team, including proper source code control practices and delivery of unit test cases.
Whether you are building applications from scratch, de-bugging existing code, or collaborating with various teams/team-members, for example, your skills will be tested and your knowledgebase will grow as you rise to meet the challenges.


Senior Programmer: Writing and maintaining code , bug fixes ,lead & contribute to design discussions, investigating and resolving production issues , code review, develop frameworks and work with development manager to lead the development team.
In this role, you will be using the experience you have gained throughout your career to assist in the design, development, and implementation of SIEM and SOAR capabilities across an Enterprise environment
Perform spike/proof of concept as necessary to mitigate risk or implement new ideas.
Code solutions and unit tests to deliver a requirement/story per the defined acceptance criteria and compliance requirements.
Utilize multiple architectural components (across data, application, business) in design and development of client requirements.
Design/develop/maintain automated test suites (integration, regression, performance)


Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, or related technical discipline
Experience Range: 8+ years


Previous Application Programming/Development experience designing, developing and deploying high-volume, multi-tiered, distributed transactional applications.
Deep knowledge of Python Django Framework
Deep knowledge of Angular, ES6/HTML5/CSS3
Strong knowledge of MySQL databases
Strong understanding of unit testing frameworks
Experience working in Agile development process and good understanding of various phases of Software Development Lifecycle
Experience in data access technologies and patterns.
Relational database experience and proven abilities in SQL and data modeling is required. Must be aware of SQL Objects, query optimization, and join conditions.
Experience with component-based web application frameworks.
Conceptual understanding of Object-Oriented Programming and SOLID design principles.
Ability to communicate, written and verbal, with technical and non-technical cross-functional teams.
Bonus Skills: .NET Core, Jenkins, MS Build, Ansible, XLR, Automated testing


Recent Angular Experience
Knowledge of software development lifecycle; preferably with Agile, Kanban/Scrum
Experience with cyber security related workflows/solutions/implementation.
